messages:
alyssa: Hey team — need a creative pack for next week's OpenInfra launch. Scope: hero graphic, 3 social templates (X / LinkedIn / Mastodon), webinar slide deck template, 1-page sales diagram, and a 30s trailer. Can @leo take lead on visuals? Brand-compliant + accessible please.

leo: Yep, I can own visuals. Quick Q: do we have a final headline/messaging for the hero or should I iterate with 2 headline options?

alyssa: Iterate please — 2 headline directions: 1) 'Predictable LLM inference at scale' (technical) and 2) 'Ship LLM features faster, cheaper, safer' (product). Need initial comps by Tue 10am PT. Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/redwood-openinfra-launch (placeholder).

mike: I’ll drop the benchmark numbers and the concise messaging bullets by EOD today. Also will create the UTM strings and short social copy.

sarah: For the webinar slides, include: title slide, methodology slide, latency vs cost charts, recommended configs slide, customer outcome slide, CTA slide. Please export 16:9 PPTX and also a shareable 4:5 PNG for socials.

leo: Got the slide list. A few stylistic constraints: use Redwood primary palette, system fonts (inter), avoid photos — prefer illustrations or abstract gradients. Also will produce two visual directions (A = data-forward, B = friendly product).

leo: Deliverable export specs (will include in Figma):
```
- Hero: 2400x1350 px, PNG + SVG (for responsive crop)
- Social X post: 1200x675 px PNG
- LinkedIn feed: 1200x627 px PNG
- Mastodon / IG feed: 1080x1080 px PNG
- Webinar trailer: 1280x720 mp4 (30s), also 720x720 gif for quick shares
- Slide deck: 16:9 PPTX + PDF export, separate assets folder with SVG charts
- One-pager sales diagram: A4 PDF + PNG 2480x3508 px
```

figma-bot: Export queue created for frames: hero, social_x_A, social_x_B, linkedin_A, linkedin_B, slide_template_v1.

mike: Sample social copy: "See how we cut gen cost by 3x and improved p95 latency. Join the webinar or request the reproducible benchmark." I’ll confirm the final CTA text and provide the lead routing snippet (HubSpot form) tonight.

sarah: Accessibility checklist for exports: alt text for every image, contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for body text, headings as text layers (not flattened), slide notes with 1-line talking points. Add keyboard-friendly colors for charts.

alyssa: Also need a 1-page diagram for sales summarizing: architecture (hosted vs dedicated vs private), routing policies, and cost levers. Keep it simple — call out 3 recommended configs for customer profiles.

mike: Confirming UTM template: utm_source=redwood&utm_campaign=open-infra-launch&utm_medium=social&utm_content={variant}

leo: Will produce A/B variants for hero and social (technical vs product). Will include a version with larger chart callouts for data-driven audiences.

alyssa: Can someone ping #legal for a quick brand compliance check if we include partner logos or benchmark comparators?

sarah: I’ll ping legal. Also we need a short slide for "How we ran the benchmark" with the exact command snippet — please keep it reproducible.

alyssa: Example command we can include (will be refined by Mike):
```
run-benchmark --model redwood-13b --sequence-length 2048 --batch-size 16 --strategy=realtime --region=us-west-2
```

leo: Great. Plan: I'll upload initial comps (A/B) to Figma and attach exports to this thread by EOD tomorrow. Will also add a label on each frame for export filename and usage (hero, x-feed, linkedin, pptx).

alyssa: Amazing — thanks all. I’ll review comps Tue morning and loop in sales and comms for final messaging.

mike: On it — will drop the benchmark CSV and short talking bullets tonight.

figma-bot: Frames uploaded: hero_A, hero_B, social_x_A, social_x_B, slide_template_v1 (links in figma file).

alyssa: Perfect. If anyone needs clarification ping me or DM. :thumbsup:
